meta.title: 夏天穿短裙这样拍超级显瘦！
meta.title_en: Shoot Your Summer Skirt to Look Slim!

scenes.context: 腿往镜头前伸不往里放，架起腿放松往上倾，脚背绷起显腿长。
sentences: 坐着拍照 腿不要往里放 会特别显腿粗。
When sitting, don't tuck your legs in — it makes them look thick.
往镜头前伸 再把腿架起来。
Extend them toward the camera and cross them up.
Point your toes to make legs look longer.
paraphrase: 换种说法表达腿往里放显粗
Squeezed-in legs read as bulky in photos.
换种说法表达脚背绷直
Flex your foot so the line of your leg keeps going.
scenes.speak: When sitting, don't tuck your legs in — it makes them look thick. Extend them toward the camera, and point your toes to make legs look longer.

scenes.context: 蹲着腿易压粗，哪里有肉用手挡住；架腿显粗时换成前腿后架藏肉。
sentences: 蹲着 腿会容易压粗。
Squatting tends to compress your legs.
Cover any problem area with your hands.
我们换成前面这个腿 往后架。
Swap to the front leg and cross it back.
paraphrase: 换种说法表达蹲姿显粗
Squats squash your legs, making them look wider.
Rearrange your legs to hide the full spot.
scenes.speak: Squatting tends to compress your legs, so cover any problem area with your hands. If crossing legs looks thick, swap to the front leg and cross it back to hide that area.

scenes.context: 翘腿不是正面向后翘，而是侧伸、面向镜头的腿后翘。
sentences: Don't cross your leg straight back.
而是侧伸 面向镜头的腿后翘。
Extend to the side and cross the camera-facing leg back.
Sweep your hair and look at the camera.
paraphrase: 换种说法表达翘腿姿势
Cross the leg that's toward the camera, angled to the side.
换种说法表达撩发看镜头
Toss your hair back and meet the lens.
scenes.speak: Don't cross your leg straight back. Extend to the side and cross the camera-facing leg back, sweep your hair and look at the camera.

scenes.context: 腿往侧前方 45 度伸出去绷起脚背，双手后撑显腿长。
sentences: 往你的侧前方45度伸出去 绷起脚背。
Stretch out at 45 degrees to the front side and point your toes.
Prop yourself up with both hands behind.
双腿交叉 不要往前伸。
Cross your legs instead of reaching them forward.
paraphrase: Angle your leg out to the front-side and flex the foot.
换种说法表达手撑身后
Lean back on your hands for a longer silhouette.
scenes.speak: Stretch out at 45 degrees to the front side and point your toes. Prop yourself up with both hands behind, and cross your legs instead of reaching them forward.

practice: Don't tuck your legs in while sitting.
用「point your toes」表达绷脚背
Point your toes to make legs look longer.
Swap to the front leg and cross it back.
Prop yourself up with both hands behind.
pitfalls: 侧伸面向镜头的腿后翘
